BrokenLore: Don't Lie - Meet Miki Chan Trailer | PS5 Games
Wishlist now: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016255

Meet Miki-chan, your infallible A.I companion and new best friend! Listen to her story of a little girl who never told the truth and the price she paid for her tales.
 
Brokenlore : DON'T LIE launches on September 10th for PlayStation 5
 
BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is a Japanese psychological horror game exploring trauma, isolation, and a fractured reality where perception becomes increasingly unreliable. 
 
Step into the life of Junko, a hikikomori whose carefully controlled world begins to unravel as the past resurfaces in ways she can no longer ignore.
 
Confined to her small apartment, she struggles between daily calls, fleeting moments of intimacy, and her own destructive compulsions. Her reliance on medication slowly unravels reality itself, leading her into warped visions and liminal spaces where nothing is what it seems.

text:
Turnip Mountain - Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019285

Turnip Mountain is a physics-based climbing adventure built around a unique control system: each hand is controlled independently. Enjoy a natural and satisfying climbing experience. Master your momentum as you grip walls, swing from ropes, launch yourself across gaps and discover your own route to the summit. Every move depends on your skill, making every successful climb its own reward. 

Key Features
    
- A truly unique control system: Control hands independently.
- Physics-based climbing: Grab, swing, push and build momentum to overcome obstacles and reach new heights.
- Local co-op mode: Share the challenge with a friend, with each player controlling just one arm.
- Multiple paths to the summit: Experiment with different routes, discover shortcuts and find your own way up the mountain for greater replayability.
- Unlock cosmetic items: Collect colour palettes to completely change the visual appearance of your climber. Or collect coins to don some fancy headwear!
- Bop to the top with a pitch-perfect soundtrack by Isabelle Chiming
